item.title: Judge ends deportation case for OC father of 3 Marines who was detained last summer, report says
item.description: A judge has dismissed the deportation case of Narciso Barranco, a local landscaper and father of three U.S. Marines who was taken into immigration custody last summer, according to The New York Times.

item.title: Orange County community voices outrage over school district proposal to support ICE
item.description: The Placentia-Yorba Linda Unified School District considered a resolution affirming the district's support for federal immigration officers, among other law enforcement.

item.title: Support a good cause with t-shirts designed by SoCal artists
item.description: Proceeds from ABC7-inspired merchandise support AIDS Walk Los Angeles, the LA Regional Food Bank, the LAFD Foundation and spcaLA.

item.title: Palisades Fire victims start online platform to address insurance issues for those rebuilding
item.description: Pali Builds is an online tool for homeowners, home builders and architects that bridges the gap between insurance companies and contractors.

item.title: DHS Secretary Noem's San Diego visit draws protesters demanding her resignation
item.description: Protesters showed up outside a San Diego detention facility as DHS Secretary Kristi Noem held a press conference touting the Trump administration's drug seizure efforts.

item.title: CA Department of Justice launches civil rights investigation into Eaton Fire response
item.description: The California Department of Justice has opened a civil rights investigation that will examine emergency preparations and response efforts during last year's Eaton Fire.

item.title: SoCal to see sunny, mild conditions through Valentine's Day before rainy weather arrives
item.description: Enjoy a few more days of sunshine and mild temperatures before rainy weather arrives in Southern California next week.

item.title: Hawthorne man accused of sending fake ransom note to Guthrie family appears in Tucson federal court
item.description: A Hawthorne man accused of sending a fake ransom note connected to Nancy Guthrie's kidnapping case appeared in a Tucson federal courtroom on Thursday, according to federal investigators.

item.title: Pam Bondi's comment about crime in Culver City draws confusion, pushback from residents and mayor
item.description: The statement quickly spread online and prompted an amused - and baffled - reaction from people who live in the city.

item.title: Suspect leads LAPD on dangerous, 100 mph high-speed chase through San Fernando Valley
item.description: A suspect who was believed to be armed led police on a dangerous, high-speed chase Thursday night through the San Fernando Valley.
